shortTermThrottle.scope: Approximate per Cloudflare location; shared by MCP and HTTP agent routes, including preflight and failed requests. Shared proxy IPs share the allowance.

accessPolicy.websiteAndVideoPlayback: Public and outside the agent-service throttle.
accessPolicy.newsletterSubscription: Separate opt-in; never implied by login.
accessPolicy.agentService: OAuth required for MCP and HTTP manifest/catalog/workflow routes. No anonymous fallback.
accessPolicy.publicBootstrap: SKILL.md, connection links and OAuth discovery remain public.

updatePolicy.refresh: Every authenticated tool call and HTTP agent read resolves the current published main revision.
updatePolicy.clientBootstrap: Keep the existing MCP endpoint and installed bootstrap skill.
updatePolicy.additiveVideoFields: Exposed by get_launch_video and HTTP catalog as additionalMetadata.
updatePolicy.additiveManifestFields: Exposed in MCP manifest and at the root of the HTTP manifest.
updatePolicy.breakingChanges: Renamed core fields or a new major schema need a server adapter. Changed tool names, endpoint URLs or permissions may require client refresh or reconnect.
updatePolicy.website: Website layout and media assets use their publishing pipeline; the agent reads the published catalog and workflow.
updatePolicy.authenticationMigration: Existing unauthenticated installations must reconnect once for OAuth. Future catalog and workflow updates keep the same connection.
